name: Post Supplier Invoice (3-Way Match)
objective: Create a Supplier Invoice referencing the Purchase Order, match it to the PO and Goods Receipt (3-way match), simulate the posting, then post it and capture the resulting invoice document number.
preconditions: The Purchase Order exists and has a completed Goods Receipt against it; the invoicing party (supplier) is authorized to bill against this PO.
learningObjectives: After this section you can create a Supplier Invoice header referencing a Purchase Order.
After this section you can assign PO line items to the invoice and match the gross amount to the PO reference.
After this section you can simulate an invoice posting before committing it, and capture the resulting document number.
commonErrorsAndTips: Invoice Date left outside the allowed open posting period. The system will reject posting with a period-closed error; use today's date unless backdating is specifically required.
Gross Amount not matching the PO/GR value. The 3-way match will show a variance warning; either correct the amount or confirm the variance is expected before proceeding.
Skipping Simulate before Post. Simulation surfaces account-determination and tax errors before they become a failed posting; always simulate first.
An unexpected confirmation dialog (e.g. a duplicate-invoice warning) can block the flow if not dismissed. Check for and dismiss any warning dialog before assuming the next step failed.
